title: Backward scan on a unary tape
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean input, let $p$ be an input-head position, and let $k$ be an AND, OR, or NOT gate kind. Choose $c,t\in\{0,1,2\}$, a program counter $pc\in\{0,\ldots,63\}$, three work tapes with head positions, a natural number $m$, and an output word. Suppose tape $t$ contains $m$ consecutive ones starting at cell $0$. For every natural number $d\le m$, the machine started in state $\mathrm{prB}(k,c,pc,t)$ with the head of tape $t$ at cell $m-d$ reaches state $\mathrm{em}(k,c,pc+1)$ after $d+1$ steps, with the input-head position, all tape contents, all other head positions, and the output word unchanged, and the head of tape $t$ at cell $m$.
hypotheses_covered: Input-head position p among the positions for w
Gate kind k is AND, OR, or NOT
Indices c and t lie in {0,1,2}
Three work-tape contents and head positions
Tape t is the unary tape of m
